snippet.title: LE FOL IN 1 MINUTE
snippet.description:
LE FOL is a point-and-click game featuring multiple endings narrative, puzzles and poetry, inspired by THE FOOL'S JOURNEY, an interpretation of the MARSEILLE TAROT.

more info at https://linktr.ee/lefolgame
